verdict.rationale: Trello documents its own REST API, with API-key generation, user-token authorization, and endpoint groups such as Batch, Search and Webhooks, plus an MCP server for connecting AI tools. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API covers everything the UI can do, so only the depth of coverage is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI feature parity, an endpoint reference covering UI features (cards, lists, boards, automation, Power-Up features), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
